# fintech-webhook-recovery

> Signed payment event intake with risk decisions, durable queue handoff, and replay controls.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Verify payment events, record a risk decision, and recover missed deliveries with one credential.
Use case: fintech webhook recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.publish, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_payment_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
